name: labs/jordvl__pylabrobot-open-science-nd1000
title: Thermo Fisher NanoDrop 1000 spectrophotometer (Code/nanodrop.py:NanoDrop1000)
intro: Thermo Fisher NanoDrop 1000 spectrophotometer (Code/nanodrop.py:NanoDrop1000), adapted from jordvl/pylabrobot-open-science-nd1000. It reads `raw_spectrum`; sets `lamp`, `magnet` and `integration_time`; runs `measure_spectrum` and `take_blank`. `measure_spectrum`: acquire an optical or mass spectrum over a declared wavelength or mass range and return the axis and intensity arrays, or an artifact reference for large spectra. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
